rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose choice when something is unusually or especially intense, such as 特別快 for “extra fast.”
Use this colloquial intensifier when emphasizing that an adjective applies to a very high degree.

example.jyutping: ni1 bui1 gaa3 fe1 ging6 fu2

rows.note: Use this informal intensifier before an adjective for an emphatic “super-” sense, especially in casual speech.

example.jyutping: nei5 gam1 jat6 ciu1 leng3 wo3

rows.note: For ordinary additional work, pay, time, or items, 額外 is the all-purpose choice; it does not imply that they are unnecessary.

example.english: I have to work overtime this month, so I get extra pay.
example.traditional: 我今個月要加班，所以有額外工資。
example.jyutping: ngo5 gam1 go3 jyut6 jiu3 gaa1 baan1 so2 ji5 jau5 ngaak6 ngoi6 gung1 zi1

rows.note: Use this when the extra thing is surplus, unnecessary, or not wanted, rather than merely additional.

example.english: You bought so much water; those extra bottles are unnecessary.
example.traditional: 你買咁多水，嗰幾支係多餘㗎喇。
example.jyutping: nei5 maai5 gam3 do1 seoi2 go2 gei2 zi1 hai6 do1 jyu4 gaa3 laa3

rows.note: This is the all-purpose colloquial noun for an added thing, rather than a specifically added charge.

example.english: Besides the basic content, this course has lots of extra stuff.
example.traditional: 呢個課程除咗基本內容，仲有好多額外嘢。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 fo3 cing4 ceoi4 zo2 gei1 bun2 noi6 jung4 zung6 jau5 hou2 do1 ngaak6 ngoi6 je5

rows.note: Use this specifically when the extra is an additional charge on a bill.

example.english: Why is there an extra charge on the bill?
example.jyutping: zoeng1 daan1 dim2 gaai2 jau5 fu6 gaa1 fai3 gaa3

rows.note: Use this for a person with a small or nonspeaking role in a film or play.

example.english: They were an extra in the film and had no lines.
example.traditional: 佢喺套戲入面做臨時演員，冇一句對白。
example.jyutping: keoi5 hai2 tou3 hei3 jap6 min6 zou6 lam4 si4 jin2 jyun4 mou5 jat1 geoi3 deoi3 baak6

rows.note: Use this for behaviour, reactions, or presentation that is dramatically over-the-top or excessive.

example.english: You were only five minutes late; getting that worked up is really extra.
example.traditional: 你只係遲到五分鐘，咁激動真係誇張喇。
example.jyutping: nei5 zi2 hai6 ci4 dou3 ng5 fan1 zung1 gam3 gik1 dung6 zan1 hai6 kwaa1 zoeng1 laa3
